column1: # Thread sanitizer baseline: the reports the gate accepts.
# with the verdict and reasoning for each entry, is thread-baseline.md; the
# ledger column names the section. Lines starting with # are comments.
#   kind      the report's kind, as on its WARNING line (data race, ...)
#   access    the top application frames of the report's first stack, as
#             sanitizer_summary.py prints them: one frame, or for a block
#             copy or dispose helper the helper and the next two application
#             frames, joined by " ; ", top first, with the .N uniquing suffix
#   previous  the same for the "Previous ..." stack, or - if there is none
#   location  the report's "Location is" description with addresses and
#             thread numbers removed, or - to accept any
#   ledger    where the entry is judged
